# stdlib_keys_delete (Data Source)

Return the input map parameter with the keys parameter deleted from the map. The data source will return an error if any of the keys in the keys parameter do not exist in the map parameter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Remove the "foo" and "baz" keys from a map:
data "stdlib_keys_delete" "foo" {
  map = {
    "hello" = "world",
    "foo"   = "bar",
    "baz"   = "bat"
  }
  keys = ["foo", "baz"]
}
# result => {"hello" = "world"}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `keys` (List of String) Names of the keys to delete from the map. This must be at least length 2; otherwise use the singular version of this data source.
- `map` (Map of String) Input map parameter from which to delete the keys.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Constant value for efficiency. This is not used in plugin framework.
- `result` (Map of String) Function result storing the map with the keys removed.
